objective: Transition World of IT to Firebase architecture per updated plan/world_of_it_project_pack/docs: Firebase Auth, Firebase Realtime Database with Security Rules, Python Linux desktop agent with RTDB streaming/polling, and Flutter client app with live stream listeners
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: Firebase CLI installed and configured with .firebaserc and firebase.json targeting world-of-it-app
AC-02: Firebase Security Rules (database.rules.json) enforce deny-by-default and strict user UID isolation matching DATA_MODEL.md
AC-03: Flutter application integrates firebase_core, firebase_auth, and firebase_database with multi-platform FirebaseOptions and live Realtime Database streams
AC-04: Linux desktop agent supports Firebase Realtime Database REST/SSE events, heartbeats, allowlisted actions (shutdown, restart, sleep, health_check), and loop-free clipboard synchronization
AC-05: Local emulator configuration (Auth 9099, Database 9000, UI 4000) enables zero-cloud cost and offline test execution
AC-06: Complete verification suite passes with 12 Python tests and 6 Flutter tests with VERDICT: PASS
non_goals: Oracle VM deployment (explicitly excluded by updated architecture)
Custom WebSocket server mandatory requirement (replaced by hosted Firebase Realtime Database)
Plaintext passwords, tokens, or clipboard text stored in logs or rules
